# Obsidian community listing

The text on the plugin's page at community.obsidian.md is maintained by hand in
the directory's own form; nothing syncs it from this repo. This file is the
source of truth: edit it here, then copy each field over.

The long overview on that page is the README, which the directory reads
directly, so it needs no copy here.

Keep the facts in step with the plugin: the provider list below goes stale
whenever `PROVIDER_TEMPLATES` or the provider directory changes, so check it
before every release (see "Before cutting a release" in `AGENTS.md`).

## Tagline

Chat with an agent that knows your notes, search by meaning, and see your vault grouped into topics. Runs on Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.

## About

Turn your vault into an AI-assisted second brain. Chat with an agent that searches and reads your notes, edits them with every change staged for your review, browses the web, and works with plugins like Dataview, Tasks, and Canvas. Answers are grounded in your own notes through hybrid search that fuses semantic and keyword retrieval. A smart graph groups related notes into topics automatically, revealing structure you never linked by hand — zoom into a topic or pull back for the whole picture. Search and the graph work on their own, with no AI provider configured. Connect one — Ollama, LM Studio, or oMLX locally, or OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, and many more in the cloud — to enable the agent. Pair a local chat model with a local embedding model and nothing leaves your machine. There is no telemetry.
